time_estimate_policy.unit: active hours of one executing engineer/agent, including active evaluation/review; waiting excluded
time_estimate_policy.method: Bottom-up work packages stated per component; lower bound assumes existing contracts reusable and no new major defect, upper bound includes an additional correction/evidence round. These are planning estimates, not measured completion forecasts.
time_estimate_policy.do_not_sum: Shared dependencies overlap (semantic/context/search, Automotive/demo/cross-module, economics/performance, localization/UX). Rows must not be added into a promised total date.
time_estimate_policy.waiting: Known automated run durations are separated from external scheduling. Unknown access/reviewer waits have no honest upper bound until availability is established.
time_estimate_policy.scope: No parallel agents assumed; no Run 3–7 expansion; no automatic authorization for credentials, paid provider use, merge or production changes.
